g.text: um, remember a while ago, when i told you about those nightmares i was having...?
um, remember that fight we had a while ago... when i wasn't okay and you asked why i wasn't okay...
i was wondering if you had a second i just i need someone to talk to and nobody...
and i said it wasn't anything but it obviously WAS and... yeah... that whole thing?
well first i just wanted to say um *sorry* about all that losing my temper shit
i'm sorry i couldn't talk about it then, i just... it's rough
I'm here to listen, if you need to talk.
you heard my story, i was a FREAKING INTERN
i'm not a soldier like everyone else, or used to seeing war like eleanor
i don't know how to - to cope - and - and the nightmares...
who clicked on shit he shouldn't have and was stupid enough to think he was special
who got mixed up with the wrong people at the wrong time
how can i be a hero if i wake up crying
because i see their faces as they're dying
Oh, Sol... Amir... I don't know, and I wish I could tell you. But you belong.
I've been where you are. I still am where you are, sometimes.
Have you talked to Arthur about this?
I don't think I can help you.
You're doing the best you can. And that's all anybody can ask.
I was just a kid when the Man in the Wall turned the parents on us aboard the Zariman.
He cares about you. A lot. Like a little brother.
And I had to witness the slaughter. And I had to...
He might know how to help.
And I'm going to say it all caps in hopes it sinks in this time.
And I still have nightmares sometimes. About that.
Don't be. Everyone needs help sometimes.
A mentor of mine once said "only a stubborn fool refuses a needed hand to stay seated in the mud."
And that's okay. Talking about it is... supposed to help. lol.
nothing normal about any of this situation
all right, i'll go talk to arthur even if it's the last thing in the world i wanna do
He is. And I was a very stubborn fool.
::sigh:: thanks for listening... i'll just... go play some more games and go back to bed
i just get in the way, i'm the annoying little brother on a good day
and the liability on a bad one
I mean it, the Hex cares. *We* care.
Okay, well, Quincy is a special case, but -
Look, Amir. I've tried convincing you, but you're not 12 anymore. This isn't school.
Chat ends. Next chat will be AmirArthurNightmares.
As... more than a friend, if I'm being honest...
And I don't know how to prove it to you except to say it.
you're right it isn't it's a fracking warzone with MONSTERS IN IT
So, yeah. I care about you.
And to be here when you need me to be here.
The rest of us really do care.
So if you get those nightmares again, and you want to talk?
i can't really process that right now, but...
I don't care what time it is.
Chat ends. Next chat will be AmirArthurNightmares.
